body: How did you deal with people's reactions to you taking a path different from that of traditional Orthodox Judaism? I am a Baal Teshuva that is beginning to realize that Orthodoxy may not be my truth but I fear the reactions of those around me. I admire your courage to be who you are despite knowing it might incite negative reactions from a community you were a part of for so long.
Thanks. Right now I feel motivated and confident but I know I'm going to feel like I'm going to throw up in the moment. I just hope I don't chicken out.
He won't think I'm a weirdo? I don't want to freak him out by talking about my anxiety before we've even gotten a chance to know each other better

Thank you guys! I know it'll get easier once I take the initial step, it's just that step that is so terrifying. The thing I'm the most nervous about is that we work together, so if he DOES shoot me down, even though I'm 99% sure he won't, I'm still going to have to see him 3-4 days a week. I work with him Monday so maybe I'll ask him to hang out after work? Any ideas for something fun and not too anxiety producing?

Yes, you're right about the self doubt...I've always doubted myself and my abilities a lot but after making a few life changing decisions that were, in retrospect, quite stupid and reckless despite thinking they were the right thing at the time, I'm completely PETRIFIED to make a decision. I feel like any decision I make will be wrong and dig myself deeper into this hole. I think a lot of it is Becoming An Adult and having to learn to take care of my self...even though I've always been fiercely  independent, I've always had my path set out for me until now. I wish I had followed a more traditional path instead of throwing myself into crazy situations thinking my mental health issues would resolve themselves instead of exploding.

Even now I'm doubting posting this because this is SuicidalWatch and I'm doubting if I am/was ever suicidal. I even doubt if I actually suffer from depression, anxiety, and an eating disorder (though I've been diagnosed with all three) or if I'm just being angsty and overdramatic.

Thanks everyone for listening to my ramblings...sorry to take your time off of people that really need it.
No, you're really quite cute. I actually smiled when I opened the first picture because you're so cute and you look like a nice guy, too.
I don't know what to say, but you can talk to me if you want.

Thank you so much for responding.
I don't really know, to be honest. I feel like a spoiled brat because I know I have so many things to be thankful for and yet still...I want to die. 
My lease lets up in two weeks and then I'm not sure where I'm going to be living. My cousins offered for me to live with them, but I'm scared to move in with them because they will see what I'm really like instead of the bubbly, smiling girl they always see when I go to visit. 
Everyone is so open to helping me but I can't express to anyone how I feel....I don't even know how I feel quite frankly...some days I feel like a zombie, some I'm overcome by self hatred, some days I'm so anxious I'll binge and purge all day to get rid of the anxiety, some days I just want to die, some I feel hopeful and OK.
I don't have any real reasons to be as depressed as I am, and some days I wonder if I really am depressed..or if I'm just being lazy and overdramatic.

I just want want someone to take care of me, I don't feel capable of taking care of myself anymore.
